name: Tharil'zun
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
narrative.objectives: Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 21 to 25, 4,200 XP in all.
